Repo.name: X-Vidjutsu-Repo

background.description:
`solid` (default): a dark box behind each line; `none`: white text
with a thin dark edge.

on.description: Default true: sending captions turns them on.

size.description: `small`, `medium` (default) or `large`: 4, 5 or 6.4% of the frame height.

file.description: The SRT or WebVTT file's text.

name.description: A file name for it, e.g. `demo.srt`.

black.description: Black picture as rendered, in timeline seconds.

gain.description: The clip's gain ratio; null is unity.

gaps.description: Stretches of a track with no clip, exact.

integrated_lufs.description: EBU R128 integrated loudness; null when silent (below -70 LUFS).

no_sound.description: Where no audio track has a clip, exact.

integrated_lufs.description: EBU R128 integrated loudness; null when silent (below -70 LUFS).

CheckProject.description:
`POST /v3/projects/{project}/checks`: measure a branch head (or a pinned
revision) as a background job.

sections.description:
Stretches of the timeline to measure loudness of, such as scenes:
`{name?, from, to}`, up to 200, inside the timeline. Absent: one per
30 seconds.

CleanAudio.description:
`vidjutsu clean-audio`: speech tracks (and an optional music bed) through
the audio port, with the Auphonic adapter injected here at the
composition root. Inputs are stored media hashes (or, from the CLI, local
files). The result is made timeline-ready like `ingest` and returned as a
media object whose lineage names the vendor's output and every input.

music.description: Music bed kept under the voice.

music_db.description: Music level under the voice, dB.

parts.description:
Every part, numbers 1 to the part count (empty when the start said
`already_stored`).

EditProject.description:
`vidjutsu edit` / `POST /v3/projects/{project}/edits`: operations applied
to a branch head as one atomic commit. Times may be plain seconds (`12.5`,
`"12.5"`, `"1001/30000"`). The body is a list of operations, or an object
with `operations` and optionally `branch`, `repo`, and for safe retries
`expected_head` plus `idempotency_key`.

author.description: Who is editing, as Activity shows it ("Claude Code", "Max").

expected_head.description:
The head this edit was written against; a moved head is a conflict.
Absent: the current head.

operations.description:
Edit operations applied as one commit, each named by `op`:
`add_media` (`media`: an `ingest` result's media object),
`insert_clip` (`track_id`, `occurrence`: `{id, media_id, source:
{start, end}, timeline_start}`, `ripple`), `delete_clip`,
`move_clip`, `trim_clip`, `swap_media`, `set_gain`, `set_fade`,
`cut_pauses`, `add_track`, `set_layout`. Times are seconds (`12.5`)
or rationals (`"1001/30000"`). See docs/FORMAT.md#edit-operations.

summary.description:
One line for Activity ("Cut 14 filler words"); default: made from
the changes.

FrameProject.description:
`POST /v3/projects/{project}/frames`: stills of a branch head (or a
pinned revision) at timeline times, as a background job.

height.description:
Still height in pixels: 360, 720 (default) or 1080. Stills are 16:9,
like the render.

times.description:
Timeline times, 1 to 24, each before the end: seconds (`12.5`) or
rationals (`"1001/30000"`). Each still is the output frame (30 fps)
whose span holds that time, so `t` and `t - 1/30` are the frames on
either side of a cut at `t`.

frame.description: The output frame (30 fps) whose span holds the asked-for time.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

configured.description: Whether the server's accounts are usable.

at_seconds.description: Where, on the timeline the revision made.

kind.description: cut, gap, insert, place, remove, move, trim, swap, gain, fade, layout, add_media or add_track.

undoable.description: Whether `undo` can undo it on its own.

words.description: For a cut of transcribed media: the words it took out (empty: a silence).

kind.description: init, edit, level, restore or undo.

next.description: Pass as `before` for the next page.

ImportTimeline.description:
`POST /v3/imports` / MCP `import_timeline`: a Descript timeline export
(FCPXML or EDL) as a new project.

author.description: Who is importing it, as Activity shows it.

files.description:
One `ingest` result per file the export names (`{name, media,
audio}`), matched to clips by file name.

format.description: `fcpxml` or `edl`; absent: told from the text.

idempotency_key.description: Retrying with the same key returns the first result.

skipped.description: What the export held that a timeline doesn't (captions, markers), with counts.

trimmed.description: Clips cut back to their file's end (by at most one frame, from Descript's frame snapping).

IngestUrl.description: `POST /v3/media` with a JSON body, and the `ingest` MCP tool.

name.description: File name for the media id; default: the link's last path part.

url.description: An `https://` link the server downloads (a presigned link works).

audio.description: A video's sound, as audio media.

conform_at_render.description: Whether render boxes convert the parts of this video a render uses (it is stored as is).

converted.description: Whether the file was transcoded before storing (`ingest --eager`, or a still that became PNG).

InitProject.description:
`vidjutsu init` / `POST /v3/projects`: a project from a manifest, or an
empty one with one video and one audio track (`v1`, `a1`) ready for
`insert_clip` edits.

author.description: Who is creating it, as Activity shows it.

idempotency_key.description: Retrying with the same key returns the first result.

manifest.description:
A full project manifest (see docs/FORMAT.md); absent: an empty
project with tracks `v1` (video) and `a1` (audio).

media.description: A preview's or transcript's media hash.

url.description: A fresh 7-day link on every read.

output.description: The rendered file, the preview, the stills or the check's values, once succeeded. A transcript's words are read from its route.

project.description: Empty for a preview or transcript.

report.description: The CLI's render report (timings, box log), or null.

revision.description: Pinned when the job was created.

started.description: Starting a preview, transcript or Studio Sound: whether this request started the job (false when it exists or is running).

box_seconds.description: Wall-clock box time, from creation to stop.

final.description: The job has finished: these numbers will not change. Record them once, by job_id.

frames.description: A frames job: stills drawn (null when it failed).

output_seconds.description: A render: length of the rendered film; a check: length of the timeline checked (null when it failed).

source_seconds.description: A preview or transcript: length of the source. Studio Sound: length of the voices sent to Auphonic. Null when it failed.

usage.description: What the job used, once boxes have run (also for failed and canceled jobs); null when none ran.

JsonRpc.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 message or batch; see docs/MCP.md.

LevelAudio.description:
`vidjutsu level` / `POST /v3/projects/{project}/level`: measure what each
clip on the audio tracks plays (EBU R128) with local FFmpeg reading the
stored media, then set gains so each plays at `target` LUFS, as one edit.
Gains are rounded to thousandths (an explicit rounding at this adapter
boundary) and clamped to the gain bounds.

author.description: Who is leveling, as Activity shows it.

interval_seconds.description: Thumbnail i shows the source at i * interval_seconds.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

job_id.description: The job making (or that made) it.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

encoding.description: One byte per peak, 255 full scale.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

author.description: Who made this revision, as they named themselves.

cleaned.description: Of those, clips playing a cleaned copy.

revision.description: The revision that turned it on; undo it to turn it off.

state.description: `on`: every clip on the audio tracks plays a cleaned copy.

boxes.description: Box cap for this render (default from config).

captions.description:
Burn captions in, from the words heard on the edited timeline (every
sound on it needs a transcript). One plain style: white sans on a
solid box, or on nothing. Leave out (or `on: false`) for none.

ffmpeg.description: Renderer fingerprint override (default: recorded by setup).

force.description: Render even if this exact output exists.

hedge.description: Duplicate slow jobs on idle boxes.

loudness.description: Normalize the final mix to this integrated loudness (LUFS).

revision.description: Render this revision instead of the branch head.

split.description:
`cuts`: ranges follow clip boundaries so edits reuse untouched
ranges; `grid`: fixed ranges from frame 0.

RestoreProject.description:
`restore` / `POST /v3/projects/{project}/restore`: bring back an earlier
revision's timeline as a new revision on top of the branch head. History
is never rewritten.

author.description: Who is doing it, as Activity shows it ("Claude Code", "Max").

expected_head.description: The head this was decided against; a moved head is a conflict.

revision.description: The revision whose timeline comes back.

summary.description: One line for Activity; default: says which revision came back.

restored.description: The revision whose timeline came back.

SentPart.description: One sent part: its number and the `ETag` header its PUT returned.

bytes.description: The file's exact length in bytes.

name.description: File name for the media id (`take1.mov` becomes media `take1`).

sha256.description:
The file's SHA-256, 64 lowercase hex digits. The server checks the
stored bytes against it before keeping them.

stored_bytes.description: Bytes stored for this repository: media, renders, caches and history.

author.description: Who turned it on, for the project's history (one line).

media.description:
Clean only these voices (media ids played on audio tracks). Absent:
every audio media the audio tracks play, music included, so leave
music out here when it should stay as it is.

untranscribed.description: Media on the timeline without a transcript.

job_id.description: The job making (or that made) it.

url.description: A fresh one-day link on every read.

UndoProject.description:
`undo` / `POST /v3/projects/{project}/undo`: undo one change of a
revision (`change`, its index in `history`), or all of it, as a new
revision. Undoing the head as a whole restores its parent; anything else
applies the changes' inverses to the current head, so later edits stay.

change.description: Which change (its `index` in `history`); absent: the whole revision.

revision.description: The revision that made the change.

already_stored.description: The hash is already stored: send no parts, just complete.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds when the part links stop working.

part_size.description: Bytes in every part but the last (the rest).
